headline: OpenAI opens dedicated "Partner Director, PwC" role in its Partnerships team
explanation: A new "Partner Director, PwC" posting appeared in OpenAI's Partnerships team under Go To Market in San Francisco. A named partner director dedicated to a single firm signals OpenAI is building a structured channel relationship with PwC, which could expand enterprise deployment reach through a major global system integrator and consulting firm.

headline: Anthropic posts a cluster of Finance, corporate-development, and compliance roles consistent with IPO-readiness work
explanation: In a single detection window Anthropic added "Senior Manager, IT SOX", "Head of Business Controls", "Director, US International Tax Planning", "Sourcing Lead, Corporate Development", "Deal Lead, Corporate Development", and "Product Finance & Strategy, Monetization" — all in the Finance department in San Francisco. Simultaneous SOX controls, international tax, and corporate-development sourcing and deal-execution hires are the canonical pre-IPO staffing signature. Combined with new engineering management roles for Inference Infrastructure and Scheduler and Fleet Efficiency, plus two new "Strategic Deals Lead" roles for Compute Infrastructure and Compute Partnerships, the pattern suggests Anthropic is simultaneously hardening its financial controls and securing long-term compute supply — both standard prerequisites for an IPO or large capital raise.
